source_caption:
To authentically capture the intensely vulnerable, deeply complicated romantic dynamic between Marianne and Connell, the production made a groundbreaking decision that completely transformed the industry standard for on-screen romance. Recognizing that the heavy, continuous physical intimacy was the absolute psychological core of the story, the creators brought in intimacy coordinator Ita O’Brien to treat the deeply exposing scenes exactly like highly technical stunt choreography. Behind the scenes, Paul Mescal and Daisy Edgar-Jones were given incredibly strict, heavily communicated physical parameters, entirely removing the unpredictable, often unsafe pressure of traditional Hollywood love scenes. By fostering an environment of absolute, unwavering mutual trust and strict safety, the actors masterfully prove that the most visceral, breathlessly raw on-screen chemistry does not come from reckless abandon, but from the immense freedom of knowing exactly where the boundaries are.
⠀
Normal People (2020), directed by Lenny Abrahamson and Hettie Macdonald, starring Daisy Edgar-Jones, Paul Mescal, Sarah Greene. Based on the immensely popular novel by Sally Rooney, two highly intelligent, deeply conflicted teenagers from vastly different social backgrounds in a small Irish town embark on an intoxicating, fiercely complicated on-again, off-again romance that profoundly shapes the entire trajectory of their transition into adulthood.

source_details.synopsis: Normal People is a romantic drama limited series based on the 2018 novel of the same name by Sally Rooney. It was written by Rooney, Alice Birch and Mark O'Rowe, and directed by Lenny Abrahamson and Hettie Macdonald. The series follows the relationship between Marianne Sheridan (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Connell Waldron (Paul Mescal), who attend the same secondary school and the same university. The series was greenlit in 2019, with Edgar-Jones and Mescal announced to star. The remaining cast was rounded out soon after Rooney was confirmed as one of the series' writers, alongside Birch and O'Rowe.
